hook: Enriched living conditions and one-eye deprivation rewire excitatory synapses in over 100 mouse brain regions.
summary: The brain holds many types of excitatory synapses, and how experience changes their mix was unknown. Comparing mice after environmental enrichment or monocular deprivation, the authors mapped synapse populations across the brain and found each experience changes distinct subsets. The findings are in mice and show patterns of change, not behavioral consequences.
title: Experience modifies the synaptome architecture in the developing and adult mouse brain.
